hazards.description: No protected space or temporary walkway is provided for pedestrians to bypass the construction zone safely.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area adjacent to the white delineators and Jersey barriers

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The concrete sidewalk exhibits significant cracking and uneven joints, creating potential trip hazards.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection in the center of the view.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear on the road surface near the crosswalk could affect stability for some users.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Blockage
hazards.description: A green construction fence completely obstructs the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the image along the curb line

hazards.name: Faded Lane Markings
hazards.description: The white lane markings on the asphalt are significantly worn, reducing lane discipline and driver predictability.

hazards.name: Lack of Protected Pedestrian Path
hazards.description: Despite the sidewalk closure, there is no temporary protected walkway provided for pedestrians in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Adjacent to the green construction fence

hazards.name: Lack of crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible along this stretch, which may lead to mid-block jaywalking, especially given the sidewalk closure on one side.

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: Visible cracks and slightly uneven joints between the large concrete slabs could pose a tripping hazard.

hazards.name: Blank Wall Frontage
hazards.description: The long brick wall creates a lack of passive surveillance and a monotonous environment for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center, along the edge of the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access
interventions.description: Establish a protected temporary walkway using a portion of the roadway or a bypass to maintain pedestrian connectivity on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to allow pedestrians to safely reach the functional sidewalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Wayfinding
interventions.description: Provide clear signage at the nearest intersections informing pedestrians of the sidewalk closure and directing them to the open walkway.

interventions.title: Temporary Protected Walkway
interventions.description: Install a temporary walkway using water-filled barriers or scaffolding to provide a safe, separated path for pedestrians around the construction site.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Detour Signage
interventions.description: Provide clear signage directing pedestrians to the safest alternative route or crossing point before they reach the obstruction.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to narrow the roadway, slow traffic, and provide space for protected bike lanes.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Install Tree Grates
interventions.description: Install permeable tree grates to level the surface with the surrounding sidewalk while protecting the tree roots.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Streetscape Enhancements
interventions.description: Add public art or landscaping to the blank wall area to improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Temporary Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement temporary speed reduction measures and increased enforcement to protect pedestrians in the narrowed roadway environment.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Walkway
interventions.description: Install a protected temporary walkway using the space currently occupied by the concrete barriers to maintain pedestrian continuity on the left side of the street.

interventions.title: Wall Treatments
interventions.description: Incorporate public art, murals, or vertical landscaping on the blank wall to improve the visual environment and pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Ensure consistent, high-quality lighting along the walkway to maintain safety in the absence of light from building windows.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point for pedestrians, especially given the institutional context.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Bypass
interventions.description: Establish a protected, ADA-compliant temporary walkway using water-filled barriers to separate pedestrians from traffic during construction.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and uneven surfaces.

interventions.title: Construction Signage
interventions.description: Install clear signage directing pedestrians to safe crossing points or alternative routes.

interventions.title: Active Frontage
interventions.description: Incorporate windows, art, or landscaping along the blank wall to improve the pedestrian experience and natural surveillance.

interventions.title: Marked Driveway Crossing
interventions.description: Use high-visibility pavement markings or a raised sidewalk across the parking entrance to prioritize pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Tables
interventions.description: Install speed tables to reduce vehicle speeds and improve safety for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Construction Traffic Management
interventions.description: Deploy flaggers to manage heavy vehicle movements and ensure pedestrian safety at the construction site entrance.

interventions.title: Street Furniture
interventions.description: Add benches or other amenities to the wide sidewalk to activate the space and provide a more robust buffer from the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to provide physical and psychological separation between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Enhanced Construction Signage
interventions.description: Ensure clear, accessible wayfinding for pedestrians navigating around the construction site on the right.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Install a temporary, ADA-compliant walkway protected by barriers to maintain pedestrian continuity during the construction period.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access Route
interventions.description: Ensure a safe, ADA-compliant path is maintained through or around the construction zone with clear signage.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair or replace damaged concrete panels to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Streetscape Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone or planting strip with street trees to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: Roadway Restriping
interventions.description: Refresh lane markings to clearly define travel lanes and improve safety for all road users.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes are high, install a marked mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair or replace cracked and uneven sidewalk slabs to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.
